meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,助手可经 Signal 收发私聊/群组消息,也能通过 Note to Self 联系;身份为已关联的手机号。Markdown 正常渲染,语音消息默认仅占位提示。适配器直连 signal-cli,无需 Chat SDK。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Signal 时(例如“添加 Signal 频道”“连接 Signal”),技能会执行安装、扫码关联与布线流程。

say.text: 把 Signal 频道加到 NanoClaw
say.note: 执行安装、设备链接与布线流程

say.text: 我想用 Signal 消息联系助手
say.note: 会引导你用现有 Signal 账号扫码关联

say.text: 用我的手机号把 Signal 接入
say.note: 设备链接扫码,不注册新号码

howto.what_en: After install, the assistant can message via Signal (DMs/groups) and Note to Self, using the linked phone number. Markdown renders normally; voice messages show a placeholder by default. Native adapter talks to signal-cli — no Chat SDK.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect Signal, e.g. 'Add Signal channel' or 'Connect Signal'. Runs installation, QR device-link, and wiring steps.

say_en.note: Runs install, device-link, and wiring steps.

say_en.text: I want to message the assistant over Signal
say_en.note: Guides you through QR linking with your existing Signal account.

say_en.text: Add Signal using my phone number
say_en.note: Device-link scan; no new number registered.
